The real issue isn’t cutting waste—it’s redirecting taxpayer money from bloated bureaucracies to real priorities. The Fair Tax Act (H.R. 25) guts the IRS, ends hidden taxes, and forces D.C. to collect revenue transparently.

Medicaid and SNAP are riddled with fraud and overpriced contracts—reform isn’t “attacking” programs, it’s demanding accountability. The deficit exploded under Biden’s watch because D.C. treats your money like a slush fund.
